definition.direction: sign of the equal-weight universe's forward 20-day return (mean over the month's signal dates of the EW mean y_raw_20d of clean-labeled universe rows) -- what a passive 20-day tranche earned
definition.volatility: annualised std of the EW universe's daily close-to-close return (mean ret_1d over the date's universe rows, |ret_1d| > 22% split/CA days excluded) over the month's sessions; high = above the median of the 43 CV months (the same threshold classifies the holdout months)
definition.top_decile_excess_vs_ew_20d: per date: mean y_raw_20d of the top 10% by score minus the EW universe, gross of costs; averaged over the month's dates
definition.inverted_share: share of the 42 value features (40 base + 2 sufficiency, *_isnan excluded) whose monthly mean rank-IC vs y_excess_20d has the opposite sign to the feature's 43-month mean (descriptive orientation, not PIT)
